claims.claim_text: The CNN learned to detect useful road features on its own, with only the human steering angle as training signal, without explicit training to detect road outlines.
claims.normalized_text: CNN autonomously detects road features using only human steering angle as training signal, without explicit road outline training.

claims.claim_text: In an example image with no road, the activations of the first two feature maps contain mostly noise, indicating the CNN does not recognize useful features in such images.
claims.normalized_text: CNN feature map activations are mostly noise for images with no road, showing lack of recognized features.
